source_summary: Ink-wash Chinese landscape with broad empty sky occupied by inscriptions/seals, a distant river-and-hill panorama, layered rock mountains on the upper right, horizontal water shoals, and a foreground bank with bare trees, willows, and textured rocks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper tone are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_distant_hills_water
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant shoreline and low rounded hills across the left middle, including the horizontal river bands and misty wash transitions but excluding inscriptions and seals above or below.
must_preserve: soft grey wash gradations forming low hills
thin horizontal ink lines suggesting river surface and shoreline
mist-softened hill edges
subtle darker strokes at the far-left waterline

motifs.name: central_cliff_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the main vertical crag cluster in the upper middle-right: tall central rock face, adjacent rounded boulders, dark fissures, and the small ledges at its base.
must_preserve: angular contour linework on the tall cliff face
dry-brush texture strokes and vertical cracks
layered rounded rock forms to the right
dark ink accents in crevices and ledges
pale wash modeling on rock planes

motifs.name: right_sloping_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the sweeping mountain slope and ridge mass on the far right, including the diagonal descent into the valley and the small lower right hillside continuation.
must_preserve: long diagonal brush strokes defining the slope
soft grey wash transitions on the upper ridge
dark contour accents along ridgelines
rounded lower hill forms at the base
misty separation between ridge and central cliffs

motifs.name: midground_river_shoals
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal river flats and sandbar-like shoals running across the center beneath the mountains, including the narrow dark shoreline strokes and pale open water gaps.
must_preserve: long horizontal ink strokes of varying density
pale unpainted water channels between shoals
soft wash pools on sandbars
thin dark shoreline accents
low misty edges where land dissolves into water

motifs.name: central_bare_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground cluster of leafless trees rising from the lower center, including trunks, branching crowns, and the brushy shrub-like twigs around the bases.
must_preserve: multiple vertical trunks with varied ink weight
fine calligraphic branch filaments and twig networks
dry-brush bark texture on trunks
dark knots and forked branch joints
small brushy shrub strokes around lower branches

motifs.name: right_willow_spray
motifs.description: Isolate the softer willow-like tree mass to the right of the central grove, with hanging foliage strokes, leaning trunks, and drooping branch curtains.
must_preserve: drooping vertical foliage strokes
soft grey wash behind hanging leaves
slender leaning trunks and branches
dark-to-light ink variation in foliage clusters
open gaps between branch curtains

motifs.name: left_foreground_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground rocky bank with layered ledges, pale ground wash, small upright saplings, and dark contour marks at the water’s edge.
must_preserve: stratified rock ledge linework
dry-brush dark accents on cliff-like edges
pale wash flats suggesting bank surface
small thin saplings at the left edge
horizontal ground strokes leading toward the grove

motifs.name: lower_right_rocky_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the low rocky promontory and shoreline to the lower right of the tree grove, including the rounded rock shelf, dark undercuts, and adjacent sparse grasses.
must_preserve: rounded rock contours and layered striations
dark dry-brush undercut shadows
thin shoreline lines extending rightward
small reed and grass strokes near the water edge
pale wash transitions around the rock base

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
